svg.desc: nwafu-bksxk: Academic assistant for NWAFU. Timetable, grades, exams, free rooms and course selection, plus a seat monitor, on-device OCR and nwafu-connect embedded through Go FFI. Dart · Flutter · Riverpod. mobile · desktop · web.
